messages:
alex: :rotating_light: Root: We're getting elevated 429s for Dedicated pool requests in us-central started ~09:20 UTC. Autoscaler spilled workloads into hosted burst nodes causing token rate limits and client retries. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2065000001

oncall-bot: Alert from autoscaler-overspill-detector (severity=high). 18 dedicated jobs spilled, ~1200 429s/min observed. Paging @priya and @tina.

priya: Triage summary: the dedicated scheduler mis-evaluated reserved capacity after a failed probe to the capacity-manager; it treated a transient agent heartbeat as host OOS and redistributed pods. That triggered host-label mismatch and many requests went to burst pool which enforces stricter per-token limits.

tina: Immediate mitigations (applied 09:28 UTC): 1) temporarily disabled autoscale-redistribute for us-central, 2) reinstated reserved host annotation for affected pools, 3) bumped burst pool quota to soften rate limit while we stabilize.

alex: Impact: Hosted API clients saw raised 429s and some customers reported elevated latency and retries. Dedicated customers experienced degraded throughput for ~15m until reinstate. No data loss.

infra-sre: Canary metrics: 429 rate returned to baseline within 8 minutes post-mitigation. CPU variance on scheduler hosts traced to noisy VM hypervisor causing missed heartbeats.

kyle: Ops command we used to pin hosts back (ops only):

```
# pin hosts in us-central back to reserved pool
kubectl annotate nodes -l dedicated=us-central reserved=true --overwrite
kubectl rollout restart deployment/scheduler -n infra --grace-period=60
```

ops-bot: Note: scheduled controlled resync of capacity-manager at 11:00 UTC to prevent recurrence; will coordinate with infra windows.

alex: Customer comms: drafted short broadcast for affected accounts and status page updated. "Issue: transient capacity redistribution in us-central affecting Dedicated throughput and causing 429s for some hosted requests. Mitigations applied; monitoring continues." Sending now to impacted customers.

priya: Root cause action items: 1) add heartbeat jitter tolerances to capacity probes, 2) make autoscale-redistribute opt-in per-pool for next release, 3) add extra observability for host OOS toggles. Postmortem owners: @priya (root cause + fix) and @tina (playbook + comms). ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Severity downgraded to S3 at 09:45 UTC. Monitoring active. Closing interim broadcast; follow-up postmortem will be posted to #postmortems when ready. :white_check_mark:
